titleZh: 「In terms of + topic」表示「就……而言／在……方面」

example: In terms of cost, the second option is better.
exampleZh: 就成本而言，第二個選擇較好。

examples.en: In terms of cost, the second option is better.
examples.zh: 就成本而言，第二個選擇較好。
examples.highlight: In terms of cost, the second option is better.

rules.zh: 核心片語是 in terms of + topic 完整的核心片語是：【in terms of + topic】 例如：【in terms of cost；in terms of safety；in terms of quality；in terms of working hours；in terms of customer service】 詞語【better】並不是固定片語的一部分。以下兩句都正確：【In terms of cost, the second option is better.】 就成本而言，第二個選擇較好。 第二個選擇在成本方面較好。 兩句的核心片語都是 in terms of cost；片語在句中的位置不同，但意思基本相同。
rules.en: in terms of + topic in terms of cost in terms of safety in terms of quality in terms of working hours in terms of customer service In terms of cost, the second option is better. The second option is better in terms of cost.

rules.zh: 目標表達【In terms of】可以放在句首就安全而言，這條小徑適合兒童使用。 片語放在句首時，通常要在 topic 後面加逗號。正確：【In terms of price, this model is more attractive.】 錯誤：【In terms of price this model is more attractive.】 在很短的句子中，有時可以省略逗號，但學習者使用逗號會較清楚和穩妥。
rules.en: In terms of Formula In terms of + topic, + complete clause. In terms of safety, this path is suitable for children. In terms of price, this model is more attractive. In terms of price this model is more attractive.

rules.zh: 也可以放在句中或句尾這個型號在價格方面更具吸引力。 兩個計劃在成本方面有所不同。 就安全而言，哪一個選擇較好？ 句型並不是固定只能以 In terms of 開始。
rules.en: In terms of Formula Complete clause + in terms of + topic. This model is more attractive in terms of price. The two plans differ in terms of cost. Which option is better in terms of safety?

rules.zh: 在 in terms of 後面，topic 通常使用名詞或名詞片語，例如 cost、location、practical experience 或 public response。若要表達「有多昂貴」，應使用完整的疑問詞子句 how expensive it is，不可只接形容詞 expensive。
rules.en: Topic in terms of + noun / noun phrase in terms of cost in terms of location in terms of practical experience in terms of long-term value in terms of public response in terms of access to public transport in terms of expensive in terms of cost in terms of how expensive it is

rules.zh: 目標表達【V-ing】是可用的延伸形式，但不是固定片語的一部分當 topic 是一項活動或目標時，可以使用：【in terms of + V-ing；In terms of reducing waste, reusable containers are more effective.】 就減少廢物而言，可重用容器會更有效。 就增加回收量而言，這項政策十分成功。 這裏的核心仍然是：【in terms of + topic】 和 increasing recycling 只是充當 topic 的 V-ing 片語。不要使用：【in terms of to reduce waste】 應使用：【in terms of reducing waste】
rules.en: V-ing in terms of + V-ing In terms of reducing waste, reusable containers are more effective. The policy was successful in terms of increasing recycling. in terms of + topic reducing waste in terms of to reduce waste in terms of reducing waste

rules.zh: 也是較進階的延伸形式後面也可以接以 what、how、where 等開始的內容：【In terms of what students need, shorter lessons may be more suitable.】 就學生的需要而言，較短的課堂可能更合適。 就安裝速度而言，較小的系統更實際。 這些是較進階的 topic 形式，不是每一句都需要使用。
rules.en: Wh-clause In terms of In terms of what students need, shorter lessons may be more suitable. In terms of how quickly it can be installed, the smaller system is more practical.

rules.zh: 必須使用複數正確：【in terms of cost】 錯誤：【in term of cost】 即使只談論一個方面，仍然使用複數形式 terms。
rules.en: Terms in terms of cost in term of cost

rules.zh: 不可以省略或改成其他介詞正確：【in terms of quality】 錯誤：【in terms quality】 錯誤：【in terms with quality】 錯誤：【in terms to quality】 固定介詞組合是：【in terms of】
rules.en: Of in terms of quality in terms quality in terms with quality in terms to quality in terms of

rules.zh: 常與比較和評估語言一起使用經常配合以下語言：形容詞和比較級這個課程在實際經驗方面較好。 比較或變化動詞兩份工作在工作時間方面有所不同。 醫院在等候時間方面已有改善。 這些形容詞和動詞是外圍的語法結構，並不是 in terms of 固定片語的一部分。
rules.en: In terms of better worse stronger weaker safer cheaper more useful more convenient more effective This course is better in terms of practical experience. differ vary compare improve perform change outperform The two jobs differ in terms of working hours. The hospital has improved in terms of waiting times.

rules.zh: 可以一次提出多於一個方面產品按照價格、品質和耐用程度作出比較。 這項計劃在參與情況和公眾反應兩方面都很成功。 當 topic 包含兩項資料時，可以使用：【in terms of both X and Y】
rules.en: The products were compared in terms of price, quality and durability. The scheme was successful in terms of both participation and public response. in terms of both X and Y

rules.zh: 可以在一句中比較兩個不同方面報告在證據方面很有力，但在組織方面較弱。 這個結構特別適合說明一件事在某方面表現良好，但在另一個方面表現較差。
rules.en: The report was strong in terms of evidence but weak in terms of organisation.

rules.zh: 目標表達【In terms of】不是普通的「關於」通常用來提出一個評估、比較或分析的方面。自然：【In terms of cost, the first plan is better.】 就成本而言，第一個計劃較好。 不太自然：【In terms of my weekend, I visited my grandmother.】 如果只是轉換一般話題，通常使用：【As for my weekend, I visited my grandmother.】 至於我的週末，我探望了祖母。 使用 in terms of 時，後面的 topic 通常應該是可以用來比較、衡量、分析或評價的方面。放在句首就地點而言，較小的酒店更方便。 放在句中或句尾較小的酒店在地點方面更方便。 配合形容詞或比較級新路線在交通情況方面比較安全。 配合比較或變化動詞兩個社區在公共交通的便利程度方面有所不同。 用於問句就實際經驗而言，哪一個課程較好？ 用於被動句產品按照價格和品質作出比較。
rules.en: In terms of In terms of In terms of cost, the first plan is better. In terms of my weekend, I visited my grandmother. As for my weekend, I visited my grandmother. In terms of + topic, + clause. In terms of location, the smaller hotel is more convenient. Clause + in terms of + topic. The smaller hotel is more convenient in terms of location. Subject + be + adjective / comparative + in terms of + topic. The new route is safer in terms of traffic. Subject + differ / vary / improve / perform / change + in terms of + topic. The two neighbourhoods vary in terms of access to public transport. Question + in terms of + topic? Which course is better in terms of practical experience? Subject + be + compared / judged / assessed + in terms of + topic. The products were compared in terms of price and quality.

rules.zh: 比較多個方面這項計劃在成本方面具吸引力，但在時間安排方面有困難。 可選延伸這些是 topic 的不同形式，不代表所有答案都必須使用 V-ing 或 wh-clause。
rules.en: Subject + be + adjective in terms of X but adjective in terms of The plan is attractive in terms of cost but difficult in terms of timing. in terms of + V-ing in terms of reducing waste in terms of helping new employees in terms of + wh-clause in terms of what students need in terms of how quickly it works

benefits.zh: 清楚指出正在討論哪一方面一件事可能在不同方面有不同優點。第一個選擇較便宜，但第二個選擇較安全。 使用 in terms of，可以清楚標示每個判斷的準則：【The first option is better in terms of cost, but the second is better in terms of safety.】 第一個選擇在成本方面較好，但第二個選擇在安全方面較好。 讀者不會誤以為其中一個選擇在所有方面都較好。
benefits.en: The first option is cheaper, but the second option is safer. The first option is better in terms of cost, but the second is better in terms of safety.

benefits.zh: 令比較更加公平和準確這個課程較好。 這個課程在實際經驗方面較好。 第二句說明課程只是在「實際經驗」這個準則上較好，並沒有過度聲稱它在所有方面都較好。
benefits.en: Instead of simply saying: This course is better. You can say: This course is better in terms of practical experience.

benefits.zh: 幫助組織較長的答案在作文、報告、簡報或討論中，你可以逐一分析不同方面：【In terms of cost, Plan A is better. In terms of safety, however, Plan B is stronger.】 就成本而言，計劃 A 較好；不過，就安全而言，計劃 B 更有優勢。 讀者可以清楚跟隨你的分析次序。
benefits.en: In terms of cost, Plan A is better. In terms of safety, however, Plan B is stronger.

benefits.zh: 避免反覆使用較長的說法比較：【When we consider the cost, the first option is better.】 考慮成本時，第一個選擇較好。 就成本而言，第一個選擇較好。 目標表達【In terms of】可以更直接地引入評估準則。
benefits.en: When we consider the cost, the first option is better. In terms of cost, the first option is better. In terms of

benefits.zh: 可以靈活改變句子位置你可以把評估方面放在句首：【In terms of quality, this product is excellent.】 也可以把它放在後面：【This product is excellent in terms of quality.】 這可以增加句式變化，避免所有句子都以相同方式開始。
benefits.en: In terms of quality, this product is excellent. This product is excellent in terms of quality.

benefits.zh: 適合真實的學習和工作場合這個句型常用於：比較產品評估計劃分析課程討論工作表現撰寫報告比較不同政策解釋優點和缺點回答需要多角度分析的問題它能幫助你把較模糊的意見改寫成較具體和有根據的判斷。
benefits.en: This structure is useful in real study and workplace tasks: comparing products, evaluating plans, analysing courses, discussing performance, writing reports, comparing policies and explaining advantages and disadvantages. It turns a vague opinion into a specific, evidence-based judgement.
